name: motorcycle
description: A motorcycle with two wheels and a compact engine.
useCase: Identify motorcycle travel, parking or vehicle options.
misuse: Pair this symbol with a clear label when its meaning depends on context.

16.reason: A compact tank and engine join the frame between two open wheel rims. The solid engine stays more than 1px clear of the wheels; the frame meets their tops.

24.reason: The rounded tank and solid engine distinguish the motorcycle from a bicycle. The frame joins the wheel rims while more than 1.5px separates the engine from the wheels.
